summary: The presentation introduces a new framework extending the Class of Service (CoS) concept to Optical Transport Networks (OTN) to address latency and determinism challenges in multi-site computing workloads like AI training and telehealth. By combining compute-side metrics with optical-layer parameters, the proposed solution uses OTN to provide end-to-end hard isolation and map traffic into optical containers, ensuring guaranteed performance for high-bandwidth, synchronized services.
